envelope.description: Registration, coverage table, snapshot and docs

body.title: Registration, coverage table, snapshot and docs
body.summary: Register all tools in index.ts; add coverage.ts (GIT_COVERAGE with three owners: covered, assigned to s8, excluded with reason, per subcommand, git_amend's commit case included) built from git 2.53.0's 169 commands and its test that runs each covered case through executeTool in a temporary repository; update the 228-tool snapshot and approval-class mapping test for the new tools and classes; add the coverage table to docs/daemon.md.
acceptanceChecks: The coverage test checks a fixed fixture of the 169 command names, not the installed git, and accounts for every one with exactly one owner
Every covered row runs through executeTool in a temporary repository
The tool id and input schema snapshot matches for the existing tools and lists the new ones
The approval-class mapping test covers the new tools and the destructive classes

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: every command of the recorded list has exactly one owner, an assigned row is never counted as covered and every registered git tool is in the table
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: multi-operation commands are tracked per subcommand and the operations the existing schemas lack are assigned to s8
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: every covered row's case runs through executeTool and matches its assertion
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: git_amend runs its own case and git_diff with path and paths keeps its legacy failure
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/approval-class-mapping.test.ts: the tool ids and input schemas match the snapshot taken before the rewrite and list the new git tools
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/approval-class-mapping.test.ts: the approval-class mapping covers the new tools and classes
